subject: Media Literacy
title: Algorithmic Amplification of Partisan Content
description: One-minute skill: Algorithmic Amplification of Partisan Content.

hook.text: Facebook's algorithm showed that partisan posts generated 5x more engagement than neutral news. It promoted them.

buildup.text: Algorithms amplify content that generates engagement. Partisan content generates more engagement than balanced reporting.

discovery.text: This creates a structural bias toward extremes — moderate voices get drowned out by algorithmically boosted partisans.

twist.text: The algorithm isn't partisan itself. But by rewarding engagement, it systematically favors the most divisive voices.

climax.text: Technology platforms have become the largest editors in history — and they edit for profit, not for truth.

punchline.text: The algorithm isn't biased. It just rewards bias.

quiz.question: How do algorithms structurally favor partisan content?
options: Partisan content generates more engagement, which algorithms are designed to reward
